name: A Mouth of Borrowed Teeth
vestige: Dahlver-Nar, the mouth of borrowed teeth
summary: 2 more Hit Points per level, and Advantage on death saving throws. The price: Charisma -2, Disadvantage on Persuasion, and a mouthful of teeth that aren't yours.

source.note: A vestige of the Amber Temple (Curse of Strahd chapter 13 in spirit). The vestige's name is the book's; the gift, its benefit, its price and every word here are ours, designed for this game. Found in amber_temple_vault (the hall of vestiges).

benefit.text: You become very hard to finish. Something in you keeps chewing on, long after it should have stopped.

cost.flaw: Your teeth are other people's. When you are tired, they talk in other people's voices.
cost.text: Every tooth in your head is replaced overnight with a dead stranger's. Nobody likes your smile.
